quarterly_data.quarter: Rigaku press release: [Press Release] Rigaku Launches CT Lab HR160 (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rigaku announced the launch of the CT Lab HR160, a high-resolution laboratory X-ray computed tomography (CT) system for battery, semiconductor device, electronic component and advanced materials analysis, developed in collaboration with Excillum AB and built around Excillum's NanoTube N3 X-ray source. It operates at up to 160 kV and achieves true 250 nm spatial resolution, which Rigaku calls an industry-leading level for CT systems in its class (company claim); cone-beam geometry lets users adjust field of view and resolution without changing the source or detector. Target applications named: solid-state batteries, semiconductor devices, multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs) and power electronics, for R&D, quality evaluation and failure analysis.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 160 kV; 250 nm spatial resolution
